122: So that both he and she would be killed: That the king should suspect me [of consorting with Haman] and he kill both of us. [A different version: And if they issued a decree and one of them died, the decree becomes nullified.] He was a fickle king and he would change his word. She said, "Maybe I can seduce [the king] and kill [Haman]. But if he is not on hand, the time will pass and he will reverse himself."
